question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT l.id_bioguide, l.gender, lt.state, TRY_CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) AS term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
check_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.gender,
        ft.state,
        ft.term_start,
        YEAR(ft.term_start) AS start_year,
        (
            SELECT CASE 
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2
                    WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
                    AND TRY_CAST(lt2.term_start AS DATE) <= MAKE_DATE(start_year, 12, 31)
                    AND (lt2.term_end IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(lt2.term_end AS DATE) > MAKE_DATE(start_year, 12, 31))
                ) THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS served_0,
        (
            SELECT CASE 
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2
                    WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
                    AND TRY_CAST(lt2.term_start AS DATE) <= MAKE_DATE(start_year + 2, 12, 31)
                    AND (lt2.term_end IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(lt2.term_end AS DATE) > MAKE_DATE(start_year + 2, 12, 31))
                ) THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS served_2,
        (
            SELECT CASE 
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2
                    WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
                    AND TRY_CAST(lt2.term_start AS DATE) <= MAKE_DATE(start_year + 4, 12, 31)
                    AND (lt2.term_end IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(lt2.term_end AS DATE) > MAKE_DATE(start_year + 4, 12, 31))
                ) THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS served_4,
        (
            SELECT CASE 
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2
                    WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
                    AND TRY_CAST(lt2.term_start AS DATE) <= MAKE_DATE(start_year + 6, 12, 31)
                    AND (lt2.term_end IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(lt2.term_end AS DATE) > MAKE_DATE(start_year + 6, 12, 31))
                ) THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS served_6,
        (
            SELECT CASE 
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2
                    WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
                    AND TRY_CAST(lt2.term_start AS DATE) <= MAKE_DATE(start_year + 8, 12, 31)
                    AND (lt2.term_end IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(lt2.term_end AS DATE) > MAKE_DATE(start_year + 8, 12, 31))
                ) THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS served_8,
        (
            SELECT CASE 
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2
                    WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
                    AND TRY_CAST(lt2.term_start AS DATE) <= MAKE_DATE(start_year + 10, 12, 31)
                    AND (lt2.term_end IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(lt2.term_end AS DATE) > MAKE_DATE(start_year + 10, 12, 31))
                ) THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END
        ) AS served_10
    FROM first_terms ft
),
state_gender_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        AVG(served_0) AS rate_0,
        AVG(served_2) AS rate_2,
        AVG(served_4) AS rate_4,
        AVG(served_6) AS rate_6,
        AVG(served_8) AS rate_8,
        AVG(served_10) AS rate_10
    FROM check_retention
    GROUP BY state, gender
),
male_all_retained AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM state_gender_rates
    WHERE gender = 'M'
    AND rate_0 > 0 AND rate_2 > 0 AND rate_4 > 0 AND rate_6 > 0 AND rate_8 > 0 AND rate_10 > 0
),
female_all_retained AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM state_gender_rates
    WHERE gender = 'F'
    AND rate_0 > 0 AND rate_2 > 0 AND rate_4 > 0 AND rate_6 > 0 AND rate_8 > 0 AND rate_10 > 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT m.state
FROM male_all_retained m
JOIN female_all_retained f ON m.state = f.state
ORDER BY m.state
